aboutPage.name: Hi I'm Yusha | Frontend Developer
content: Hello! I’m Yusha Kuralay, born in Germany in 2001 and currently based in Turkey. My journey into technology began during my Computer Engineering studies at Ankara University, where I developed a deep interest in frontend development. Through self-driven learning, I gained expertise in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and various modern frameworks like React, TypeScript, and Next.js.

My professional career took off with freelance projects, where I built customized tools and websites for clients. This experience helped me refine my skills in creating SEO-friendly websites and delivering solutions tailored to specific business needs.

In 2022, I joined Poshet, a Netherlands-based company, where I developed innovative applications, such as BotGuise—a chatbot creation platform that leverages OpenAI API, and FullSocial, a client-focused project. Afterward, I transitioned to Arksoft in 2023, where I spearheaded the development of their flagship product, Easy2Patch. Here, I not only led the frontend development using Angular but also integrated real-time features with SignalR and ensured SEO optimization.

Throughout my career, I've had the opportunity to contribute significantly to various projects while constantly striving for growth. I’m passionate about developing user-friendly, dynamic web interfaces and am always eager to learn new technologies.
As I continue my professional journey, I look forward to building even more impactful digital experiences, combining my technical expertise with a strong drive for innovation.
